def j16(s):
 # Retained J16: operate the native select through actual pointer/keyboard events.
 s.open();s.upload(FIX/'mito.gb');s.labels(keyboard=True);a=s.snap('01-labels')
 l=s.reveal(s.page.locator('#circular-track-preset'));options=l.evaluate('(e)=>[...e.options].map(o=>o.value)');l.click();l.press('Home')
 for _ in range(options.index('middle')):l.press('ArrowDown')
 l.press('Enter');l.press('Tab');s.step('native pointer-open dropdown preset middle')
 s.history();b=s.snap('02-undone');assert b['form']['track_type']==a['form']['track_type'];assert not b.get('result_hashes');s.fresh('03-before-generate');c=s.snap('04-loaded');assert c['form']['labels_mode']==a['form']['labels_mode'];assert not c.get('result_hashes');s.gen()
